findings.title: `get_monitor_environment_context` returns original config instead of modified `config` copy
findings.body: In `get_monitor_environment_context`, lines 160-162 copy `monitor_environment.monitor.config` into a local `config` dict and replace `config["schedule_type"]` with its human-readable display value (`get_schedule_type_display()`), but line 168 returns `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `"config": config`. As a result, the `config` copy is unused and the raw integer `schedule_type` is sent in the event's monitor context instead of the display string.
